legal.title: About IMG2GRID
legal.description: IMG2GRID helps Tomodachi Life players turn images into clean pixel grids, compact color palettes, and paint-by-number guides for manual Palette House recreation.

sections.heading: Our Mission
paragraphs: Our goal is to make image-to-grid planning easier for life-sim players. The homepage is built around a simple workflow: upload an image, choose a grid size, reduce colors, preview the pixel output, and download a guide that is easier to follow by hand.

sections.heading: What We Cover
bullets: Tomodachi Life image converter workflows for photos, screenshots, pictures, and img files.
Pixel grid previews for 32x32, 64x64, and 128x128 layouts.
Color palette reduction for cleaner Palette House-style painting.
Paint-by-number guide outputs for row-by-row recreation.

sections.heading: Independence
paragraphs: IMG2GRID is a fan-made tool and is not affiliated with Nintendo, Tomodachi Life, or any official game publisher. Game names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions, corrections, or tool suggestions can be sent to support@img2grid.com.
